subject: Neurolytics pilot: request for extended onramp credits + promotional bundle
messages:
From: Evan Miles <evan@neurolytics.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: claire@neurolytics.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 11:12:00 -0400
Subject: Pilot extension & bundled credits ask

Hi Priyom —

We’ve been really happy with the latency and quality so far in the pilot; the internal R&D team has one more integration sprint and asked whether we can extend the pilot window and get a modest onramp credit so they can hit the new test scenarios.

Current asks:
- Extend pilot access by 30 days (to complete model-in-the-loop tests)
- Apply an additional 250k token credit (to cover synthetic generation for benchmarking)
- Temporary access to the Dedicated inference profile for two weeks during the busiest tests (best-effort)

We’re asking because our procurement window has slipped two quarters and we need a little runway to finalize the architecture decision. If you can bundle a short extension + credit we can commit to a scoped POC LOI by end of Q4.

Attached is a snippet of usage patterns and a one-page SOC2 summary the security team asked for. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Evan

Head of ML, Neurolytics

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Pilot extension & bundled credits ask — exec signoff requested

Marissa —

Forwarding Evan’s note from Neurolytics. Quick summary & recommended concession:

Context:
- Neurolytics is an early-stage applied ML shop (healthcare imaging lateral product) — small ARR potential now but high-signal reference if it goes well.
- Pilot usage is concentrated on 2 models; they’ve ramped activity but procurement was delayed by security review.

What they want: 30-day extension + 250k token credit + temporary Dedicated access for 2 weeks.

My recommendation (to preserve unit economics):
- Approve 30-day extension
- Approve 150k token credit (one-time) and offer a second tranche of 100k tokens if they sign an LOI committing to evaluation targets within 45 days
- Offer Dedicated access as a free 5-day window (instead of 14) to keep margin exposure limited

If you can greenlight that bundle I’ll send a formal offer and include the conditional second tranche. If you want to structure it differently (discount instead of credit, or shorter window) let me know.

Notes: they attached SOC2 summary and usage csv — security already pinged Grace but it looks like standard controls.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

+1 on Priyom’s recommendation. Couple of quick guardrails I’d add:
- Make the 150k credit unconditional and the second 100k contingent on a signed LOI or a $X committed spend (pick one).
- Limit the Dedicated free window to 5 days and require a short ops runbook so our infra team isn’t toggling things unexpectedly.
- Add a trial success criterion (e.g., 5 test cases passing at X latency) so we get a measurable close trigger.

If Marissa is okay with the conditional model for the second tranche I’d approve — keeps us from handing out too much upfront while preserving momentum.

— Ben
